content.text:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user asked me to revamp the whole Benana Mod Studio UI into a polished demo, using the frontend-design guidance at https://www.ui-skills.com/skills/anthropics/frontend-design. The goals are a clean, beautiful flow for building mods and reviewing their code, with an agent that tests the mod in action. They also asked for an Insights page modeled on the attached Gumloop screenshot (stat tiles, a credit/spend-over-time chart, breakdowns by source, and artifacts by type), plus dedicated pages for Neatlogs and Entire built into the app that surface critical information.

   Standing memory rules that still apply: push to `main` at verified milestones without asking (repo `Pratheek555/benana`, origin `https://github.com/Pratheek555/benana.git`); Opus 5.5 for spec/builder/fixer, Sonnet 5.5 for the playtester; Neatlogs hooks only in generated mod repos, never globally; never ask the user for secrets in chat and keep keys in `.env`; the neatHack submission deadline is 2026-10-12 23:55 IST. Commit messages must end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>`.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Electron 33 main process, contextBridge preload with `window.benana.invoke`/`on`, IPC handlers registered in `electron/main.cjs` (`studio.handlers({ emit, log })` is spread into the handlers map)
   - React 18 + Vite 5, plain CSS, inline SVG icons
   - Mod Studio pipeline: spec agent (Opus) → repo creation (git + Entire + Neatlogs hooks) → builder (Opus) → Maven compile → Paper 1.21.4 deploy → playtester (Sonnet, via `minecraft` MCP tools) → fixer (Opus, up to 3 attempts), with lessons persisted to `studio/lessons.json`
   - Claude Code headless sessions via `runClaude` in `electron/lib/studio/claude.cjs`, emitting `session`, `text`, `tool`, `result` events; usage normalized by `normalizeUsage` in `providers.cjs` to `{inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, costUsd}`
   - Entire checkpoints via `entire checkpoint list --json` and `Entire-Checkpoint` commit trailers; Neatlogs trace evidence via `neatlogs.evidence({sessionId})` (requires `NEATLOGS_API_KEY` and `NEATLOGS_PROJECT_ID`)
   - Design system: dark "workbench" theme, Bahnschrift display font, Segoe UI body, Cascadia Mono/Consolas for code, gold accent (#f2b544) for primary/current state, green (#7fcf5a) pass, redstone (#ec6a5b) fail, cyan (#5fd3e0) Neatlogs, violet (#b29cf7) Entire, orange (#f08f3c) blocked
   - Node `node --test` test runner

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - `electron/lib/studio/repo.cjs` (modified)
      - Added `files`, `readFile`, `diff`, and exported them alongside existing exports.
      - Snippet:
        ```js
        async function files(dir) {
          const res = await git(dir, 'ls-files', '-z');
          return res.out.split('\0').filter(Boolean);
        }
        async function readFile(dir, rel) {
          if (!(await files(dir)).includes(rel)) throw new Error('Not a tracked file in this mod repository.');
          return fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, rel), 'utf8').slice(0, 200000);
        }
        async function diff(dir, sha) {
          if (!/^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$/.test(sha || '')) throw new Error('Unknown commit.');
          return (await git(dir, 'show', '--format=%s%n%n%b', '--patch', '--no-color', sha)).out.slice(0, 200000);
        }
        module.exports = { modsDir, create, commit, checkpoints, history, files, readFile, diff, build };
        ```
      - Why: path guard so the renderer can only read tracked mod files; provides per-commit diffs for the Code view.
   - `electron/lib/studio/index.cjs` (modified)
      - Added `repoOf(id)` (throws if mod unknown or no `repoDir`) and handlers inside `handlers()`:
        ```js
        'studio:files': ({ id }) => repo.files(repoOf(id)),
        'studio:file': ({ id, path: rel }) => repo.readFile(repoOf(id), rel),
        'studio:diff': ({ id, sha }) => repo.diff(repoOf(id), sha),
        ```
   - `tests/studio-repo.test.cjs` (created)
      - 3 tests using a temp git repo in a sandbox (`BENANA_DATA_DIR` set before require): lists tracked files, rejects `../secret.txt` and missing paths with "Not a tracked file", returns a patch containing `+class Launch` and rejects `HEAD; rm -rf .` with "Unknown commit". All pass (`node --test tests/studio-repo.test.cjs`).
